paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文将目标论文[3]作为RFID感知领域的相关工作，以普通引用方式提及，未进行详细能力描述或性能对比。

evidences.evidence_quote: some works use RF signals, such as Wi-Fi[29], mmWave[2], and RFID[3], [4], [30], to capture object vibration for sensing speaker-produced sound[1], [2], [3], [29], [30] or capture body motions for sensing human-speaking sound[4].
evidences.evidence_context: On the other hand, some works use RF signals, such as Wi-Fi[29], mmWave[2], and RFID[3], [4], [30], to capture object vibration for sensing speaker-produced sound[1], [2], [3], [29], [30] or capture body motions for sensing human-speaking sound[4]. However, due to sensor limitations, these methods can sense either speaker-produced or human-speaking sound, but not both simultaneously.

However, no works are available to realize online conversation eavesdropping through RFID sensing.
